observations.observation: Persisted workflow journals, child-first cancellation, compare-and-set ownership and bounded recovery are explicit in workflow.ts.
observations.strength: Durable lineage and restart safety are inspectable.
observations.weakness: Adapter limitations can leave unfenced duplicate work.
observations.decision: Translate into Omnia receipts and explicit unknown state; do not vendor.

observations.observation: URI-keyed models, explicit worker registration and fail-closed worker errors separate buffer/view lifecycle.
observations.strength: Stable file identity and resource-aware editor lifecycle.
observations.weakness: Browser worker source is not native Tauri proof.
observations.decision: Use pointer/buffer identity and unavailable provider states in Omnia-owned IDE contracts.
